summary: Frontend-only verification of the three newly-added zebick features: /datenschutz link on kontakt + direct page, blog author box on article pages, and clickable blog categories (card badge + top filter + article category link + direct URL + unknown-category empty state). Plus regression checks (blog list=6, tools=16, kontakt consent). All items PASS.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three new features (datenschutz link, blog author box mapped from /api/team/members, clickable categories with /blog/kategorie/:category route) work end-to-end. Category route correctly outranks /blog/:slug in React Router. Card category badge is a button that navigates without opening the post. Empty state test-id 'blog-empty' shown for unknown categories. Author-role mapping verified for Anna König (Creative Director), Jan Becker (Lead Security Engineer), Lisa Schmidt (Head of Development).
